answer: At the dawn of each epoch, a beacon lists 100 slots and runs an admission auction against fake identities. Each applicant bids 50 tokens; the top 100 win entry, losers are refunded. Deposits lock for 20 epochs and return after honest work, so forging 1,000 fake identities ties up 50,000 tokens. An honest agent pays one deposit, keeps its 25-token reward, and gets it back, while an ivory badge marks each admitted agent until it unlocks.
